name: Navasfrías (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist, red at the upper hoist and white at the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Navasfrías (a tower and a lion on blue and white, and a green cross).
history: The municipal flag of Navasfrías was approved on 17 August 2016 and published on 17 November 2016; it is a square cloth of proportion 1:1 formed of two right-angled triangles joined by the hypotenuse, the first red and the second white, the colours ordinarily borne by the town's ensigns.
